# Review

## Outcome

**Request Changes**

## Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_harness` passed locally, including the new calibration tests in `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/tests/calibration_report.rs` and the existing harness/e2e suites.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_harness -- -D warnings` passed locally.
- The foundation is in place: structured status and artifact metadata are modeled in `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/src/calibration.rs:48`, `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/src/calibration.rs:100`, `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/src/calibration.rs:117`, `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/src/calibration.rs:283`, and `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/src/calibration.rs:328`.

## Findings and Gaps

- No runnable report-producing workflow or persisted report artifact was added. `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/src/calibration.rs:155` and `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/src/calibration.rs:183` only build in-memory structs; the only documented entrypoint is the test header at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/tests/calibration_report.rs:7`; and the 'full workflow' test only serializes then re-parses the report at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/tests/calibration_report.rs:395` and `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/tests/calibration_report.rs:396`. That does not meet the deliverable in `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/docs/validation_scenarios.md:496` for an auto-populated report suitable for review/release notes.
- The implementation does not cover the authoritative validation scenario set. The supposed full workflow hardcodes only three baseline scenarios at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/tests/calibration_report.rs:330` with loose ad hoc bounds at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/tests/calibration_report.rs:349` and `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/tests/calibration_report.rs:357`, while the actual validation suite enumerates eight probes at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_validation_suite.rs:1372`. Passing this smoke test therefore does not prove comparison against the literature-backed target envelopes from tanksim-6e5.7.3.
- The report schema cannot express the required 'still heuristic' notation. `CheckStatus` only supports pass/marginal/fail at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/src/calibration.rs:48`, and `ScenarioRow` has no confidence/provenance field at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_harness/src/calibration.rs:117`, but the scenario spec explicitly distinguishes validated-directionally vs still-heuristic rows at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/docs/validation_scenarios.md:479` and `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/docs/validation_scenarios.md:487`.

## Follow-up and Amendments

- Add a real calibration runner entrypoint that executes the suite outside tests, writes machine-readable report files, and emits a concise human-readable summary with artifact links.
- Drive that runner from shared validation-scenario definitions so the report covers all eight shipped probes/envelopes instead of the current three-scenario smoke loop.
- Extend the report model with confidence/provenance metadata such as `validated_directionally` vs `still_heuristic`, and surface it in both JSON and human-readable output.
